items.note: The email is addressed "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B is named in the subject line and in the body.
It says the heat "has been out since October 2."
It mentions the October 3 phone call and says "I haven't heard back from you since I called."
It says overnight temperatures are "in the 40s." It doesn't write °F, but the meaning is clear.
It asks for the heater to be repaired "within 48 hours of receiving this email."
It says "Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is courteous (it thanks her and offers to sort out any delay), but the request is clear and has a deadline.
It doesn't mention rent, so there's no threat to withhold it.
It's about 105 words with the subject line, which is under 150.
